ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information Filing by Market Entities (Order No. 3 of the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation, effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Registration Administration of Market Entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Direct Parent or Ultimate UBO Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent official corporate registrar in the country of origin of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Hague Apostille states: notarise locally, obtain apostille from the competent authority, then provide certified Chinese translation. For non-Apostille states: notarise locally, authenticate through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent, then obtain consular legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in the origin country, followed by certified Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain them sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or company registrar in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the investing entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Hague Apostille states: notarise locally, apostille from the competent authority, then certified Chinese translation. For non-Apostille states: notarise locally, country-level Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, PRC Embassy/Consulate legalization, then certified Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive alternatives; never chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for Pre-Incorporation Filings and Bank Account Opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Secretary or notary public confirming corporate minutes of the foreign investing entity's board of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Hague Apostille states: notarised board resolution, apostille by the designated competent authority, certified Chinese translation. For non-Apostille states: notarised board resolution, Foreign Ministry authentication, PRC consular legalization, certified Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be sequentially chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (and Memorandum, if applicable) of the Foreign Investing Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered company office or corporate service provider of the foreign investing entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route: notarised copy, apostille from the competent authority of the Apostille Convention state, certified Chinese translation. Consular route: notarised copy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent authentication, PRC consular legalization, certified Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive; do not chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter in Favour of the Investing Entity and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the principal operating accounts of the investing entity or UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization route depending on the bank's jurisdiction: for Hague states, notarise bank officer's signature, apostille, certified Chinese translation; for non-Hague states, notarise signature, Foreign Ministry authentication, PRC consular legalization, certified Chinese translation. The routes are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to filing, each UBO, shareholder, legal representative, director and authorised signatory must be screened against: (1) PBOC domestic anti-money laundering and counter-financing-of-terrorism watchlists; (2) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, including China-related sectoral sanctions; (3) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions Lists; (4) PRC Ministry of Public Security economic

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), and the PRC Foreign Investment Law (2019; effective 1 January 2020), together with the Regulations on the Administration of Company Registration of the State Council. The relevant corporate governance provisions include Article 24 on limited liability companies, Article 47 on the capital contribution time limit, Article 55 and Article 56 on the board of directors for limited liability companies, and the applicable provisions of the Interim Measures for the Administration of Company Registration and the Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access Pilot Free Trade Zones.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration and the designated Free Trade Zone Company Registration Service Window.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (Company Establishment Registration Form) submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Online Portal or the FTZ one-stop service window.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for a bonded warehouse logistics WFOE. The shareholders must subscribe the registered capital stated in the Articles of Association, and under the PRC Company Law (2023 Revision) the subscribed capital must be fully paid within five years from the date of establishment unless a shorter period is specified in the Articles. No blocked escrow account is required; however, foreign exchange capital contributions must be remitted through the statutory cross-border capital account and registered with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the applicable FTZ facilitation rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [●] FREE TRADE ZONE WAREHOUSING CO., LTD. (A WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY) ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT IN LIEU OF A SPECIAL BOARD MEETING IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARTICLE [●] OF THE ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION AND THE PRC COMPANY LAW. WHEREAS the sole shareholder has duly subscribed to the registered capital of the Company and the proposed legal representative has accepted appointment; WHEREAS the Company intends to conduct bonded warehouse, storage and customs supervision depot operations in the China (Pilot) Free Trade Zone; NOW THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED: (1) The Board confirms the subscription and issuance of the registered capital of RMB [●] divided into [●] ordinary shares, such shares being fully subscribed and held by the sole shareholder, and approves the capital contribution payment schedule requiring all subscribed capital to be paid into the Company's capital contribution bank account within the statutory time limit. (2) The registered office of the Company shall be established at [●], Building [●], [●] Free Trade Zone, and the Board approves the execution of the office and warehouse lease agreement, the adoption of this address as the legal and statutory registered address, and the filing of such details with the Market Supervision Administration. (3) The Board authorizes the opening of one primary corporate operating bank account and one bonded warehouse customs settlement sub-account with a locally licensed commercial bank; the Chairman, General Manager, Chief Financial Officer and Customs Compliance Officer are hereby appointed as authorized signatories with dual-signature and banking control rules, and the bank is authorized to execute SWIFT wire transfers, local clearing instruments and customs guarantee deposits subject to all AML/KYC requirements. (4) The following statutory officers are appointed effective immediately: [●] as General Manager and legal representative, [●] as Chief Financial Officer, and [●] as Customs Compliance Officer. Each appointed officer shall have authority to execute all certificates, customs declarations, EHS filings, employment contracts, lease agreements, and statutory filings necessary to carry out the Company's bonded warehouse operations. (5) The Board approves the engagement of external counsel to obtain the customs bonded warehouse registration certificate, fire safety acceptance certificate, environmental registration or impact assessment, occupational health clearance and any other licenses required by the Free Trade Zone, and each officer is delegated all incidental powers necessary to perfect these resolutions. The resolutions shall be effective immediately and may be executed in counterparts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-approval and Business Scope Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Online Portal under the State Administration for Market Regulation (FTZ Registration Service Window).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The applicant must log in to the FTZ enterprise registration portal and select the establishment of a foreign-invested limited liability company. Submit the proposed company name, the exact proposed business scope referencing bonded warehouse and customs supervision depot operations, shareholder identity information, and the intended registered capital. The system will generate a preliminary name-vetting result and may raise conflicts with existing registered names. The shareholder must correct any duplicate names and resubmit before moving to the incorporation application stage. The business scope must be drafted in strict conformity with the national negative list and FTZ selected industries, using language that contemplates bonded warehouse storage, cargo receiving/dispatch, packaging, circulation processing, customs declaration facilitation, and multimodal cargo transfer only as legally permissible. No notarization is required at this stage, but all uploaded documents must be in PDF, and digital authentication via the applicant's legal representative identity card or foreign passport is mandatory.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name application form
Foreign shareholder passport or corporate certificate of incorporation (notarized or authenticated as required)
Statement of business scope
Proposed registered capital amount and currency
Power of attorney for the registration agent, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected or suspended, the applicant must amend the proposed name and business scope and resubmit through the same portal. If the system imposes a supplemental information requirement, the applicant has the right to provide corrections within the specified statutory period; failure to respond will result in administrative closure, but the applicant may file a new application without prejudice. Any unlawful rejection may be challenged through administrative reconsideration under the Administrative Reconsideration Law of the PRC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Statutory Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial and Commercial Certification Bodies, notary public offices, and the Market Supervision Administration as recipient of notarized records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole shareholder must execute the Articles of Association, the foreign investment authorization decision, the legal representative appointment letter, the supervisory appointment letter or board appointment letter, and the registered address and warehouse lease intent agreement. These documents must be prepared in bilingual or English versions if required by the bank or customs authority, but the Chinese text shall prevail for statutory registration. Notarization is required for foreign corporate shareholders and is recommended for individual foreign shareholders when executing by proxy. All signatures must match the passport or certificate of incorporation exactly. The shareholder shall ensure that the Articles of Association contain mandatory clauses respecting the five-year capital contribution period, limitation of liability, corporate governance, liquidation, transfer of equity, and representation of legal person. Counsel shall conduct legalization or apostille procedures where the shareholder is from a non-RECP or non-apostille jurisdiction. After execution, the full set of corporate documents is ready for submission with the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association
Shareholder appointment resolution
Legal representative appointment letter
Supervisory appointment letter (or board constitution)
Lease intent agreement for the registered office and bonded warehouse location
Passport or corporate certificate of the shareholder with notarized legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or authentication officer identifies mismatch in names or dates, the documents must be replaced and re-executed by all parties. If apostille or legalization is defective, the applicant may cure by obtaining a supplementary certificate from the competent foreign ministry. Administrative refusal of oath receipt may be cured by refiling corrected instruments; if the market regulator rejects the articles on legal insufficiency, the shareholder has the right to amend and renotarize within the statutory response period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration Application to FTZ Market Supervision Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Free Trade Zone Market Supervision Administration / National Enterprise Registration Online Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The completed incorporation application package must be submitted electronically with the notarized Articles of Association and attached resolutions. The online portal requires the applicant to enter the registered capital, shareholder details, legal representative, supervisory persons, business scope, and registered address in the structured fields. The system automatically interfaces with the national credit information platform to verify enterprise name and shareholder identity. After preliminary review, the registration officer examines the compliance of the business scope with the foreign investment special administrative measures, confirms the absence of prohibited industries, and verifies that the proposed legal representative is not disqualified under company law or criminal sentencing restrictions. Upon acceptance, the authority issues the Business License for Enterprise Legal Person and the official establishment registration record. The issued Unified Social Credit Code must then be used for engraving the company seal, tax registration, customs registration, and bank account opening.
required_dossiers: Completed Company Establishment Registration Application
Articles of Association
Shareholder qualification and notarized legalization documents
Legal representative and supervisor identity documents
Registered address proof or lease agreement
Undertaking concerning paid-in capital schedule
Name pre-approval certificate or system-generated name confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the establishment application is queried, the applicant must respond within five working days through the online portal by uploading supplementary materials. If the application is suspended for name or scope issues, the applicant may delete the offending field and resubmit. If suspension is based on foreign investor negative-list prohibition, the applicant may propose a revised business scope. In cases of unlawful administrative inaction, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate judicial review under the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Corporate Legalization and Statutory Officer Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau (seal engraving), State Taxation Administration (tax registration), Social Insurance Registration Center, State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and Customs General Administration (customs registration).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the business license, the legal representative must arrange for the engraving of the company's official seal, financial seal, tax invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal at a Public Security Bureau-licensed seal engraving enterprise. Then the company must register for tax identification, value-added tax general taxpayer status, social insurance, housing fund, and import-export registration. The WFOE is required to complete the SAFE foreign exchange registration for its capital account and, where applicable, the cross-border RMB settlement agreement. The Company must also submit accurate information on the legal representative, supervisor, general manager, CFO, customs compliance officer, and ultimate beneficial owner to the enterprise credit information system. The post-registration step includes the execution of employment contracts for statutory officers, issuance of board resolutions, and the opening of the primary bank accounts. The account opening authority will conduct a documentary review of the WFOE resolutions and bank authorization forms.
required_dossiers: Business license duplicate
Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identity document
Company seal and financial seal imprint cards
Articles of Association and board resolutions
Employment contracts for statutory officers
SAFE registration application form
Customs registration application or import-export enterprise registration certificate
Tax registration information form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the public security agency or tax authority requires additional identity authentication, the applicant must present the original documents in person or via the authorized legal representative. If foreign exchange registration is rejected because of mismatch between the shareholding structure and the CAP application, the applicant must cure by resubmitting corrected board resolutions and bank account instructions. Any rejection by the tax or customs portal is curable through online rectification and re-submission; administrative complaint procedures may be invoked for excessive delay or unlawful refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Bonded Warehouse License and Physical Operating Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Administration of Customs (GACC), local Customs House with territorial supervision authority over the Free Trade Zone, Fire Rescue Department, and Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company must apply for the Registration Certificate for Customs Bonded Warehouse through the China International Trade Single Window, after the digital establishment of the customs enterprise account. The application must include the warehouse layout, computer software interface to the customs bond ledger, authorized customs personnel list, security monitoring plan, and proof of fire safety acceptance. The local customs house will perform an on-site inspection of the warehouse boundaries, bonded signage, CCTV coverage, alarm systems, double-lock supervision requirements, and goods handling equipment. For environmental compliance, the company must complete either the environmental filing or full EIA registration process with the local ecology and environment bureau depending on whether any chemical, cold-storage, or hazardous material operations are proposed. After customs approval, the company receives the bonded warehouse registration certificate and may then commence bonded goods storage. The civil defense and occupational clearance must be obtained by filing a fire safety self-inspection report and obtaining the fire acceptance opinion, plus submitting structural load and warehouse safety inspection records to the FTZ administrative committee.
required_dossiers: Establishment registration certificate / business license
Registration Certificate for Customs Bonded Warehouse application form
Warehouse layout and production plan
Customs electronic ledger interface and equipment description
Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate
Environmental filing or EIA registration certificate
Occupational safety and structural inspection reports
Personnel roster for customs liaison officer and warehouse operations manager
Civil defense emergency plan and fire drill record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the customs department raises deficiency objections, the applicant shall correct the bonded warehouse interior layout, monitoring system, or internal control ledger and resubmit within the prescribed period. If the on-site inspection identifies non-compliance, the company has the right to a reinspection after remedial action. Refusal of the fire safety certificate may be cured by upgrading fire suppression equipment and reapplying. If the environmental bureau classifies the project as requiring a full EIA instead of a filing, the company must commission a certified EIA institution, conduct public consultation, and resubmit the environmental report; if the valid license is delayed, the company may maintain operations for non-bonded goods only after receiving the business license, and must not import or warehouse bonded goods until the certificate is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China (GACC) through the territorial Free Trade Zone Customs House, together with the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, the Fire Rescue Department under the Ministry of Emergency Management, and the Free Trade Zone Administrative Committee.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registration Certificate for Customs Bonded Warehouse (Customs Supervised Bonded Depot Operating Permit), supplemented by the Free Trade Zone Logistics/Warehousing Operation Permit and the Civil Defense and Fire Safety Acceptance Opinion for the bonded warehouse facility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, in coordination with the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a general non-hazardous bonded warehouse under ISIC 5210, the project is typically classified as Environmental Registration/Filing (Category III) under the Classified Management List of Environmental Impact Assessments. If the warehouse includes cold storage using large-scale refrigeration units, chemical storage, dangerous goods handling, or significant wastewater discharge, the EIA classification is upgraded to a full Environmental Impact Report (Category I) or simplified Environmental Impact Table (Category II). No exempt status applies in a bonded depot until the environmental classification report is formally confirmed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The warehouse operation must comply with Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1996 for any sanitary or floor-cleaning discharge, with COD limited to 100 mg/L, BOD5 limited to 20 mg/L, suspended solids limited to 70 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen limited to 15 mg/L when connected to a municipal treatment system. For fugitive exhaust and volatile organic compounds from forklift emissions or packaging operations, the facility must meet the VOCs emission standard GB 37822-2019, with non-methane total hydrocarbon concentration in the workshop boundary not exceeding 60 mg/m3 on a one-hour average; boundary odor must comply with GB 14554-93. Any hazardous waste, such as waste lubricants, contaminated packaging, discarded electronic components, or chemical residues, must be identified under the National Hazardous Waste List and stored in an approved hazardous waste area, with a hazardous waste management plan and manifest tracking system, and must not be discharged into municipal sewers or stored for more than one year without a special permit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The bonded warehouse facility must obtain the Building Fire Acceptance Opinion and the Fire Safety Certificate for Public Assembly and Storage Premises from the Fire Rescue Department, confirming functional automatic fire alarm systems, sufficient fire hydrants and extinguishers, emergency lighting, smoke extraction, and compliant evacuation routes. A structural load inspection certificate from a qualified structural engineer must demonstrate that the racking system and bonded goods stack loads cannot exceed the building floor load-capacity, and the warehouse must maintain a Civil Defense and Emergency Evacuation Plan approved by the Free Trade Zone administrative committee. The company must also obtain an occupational health and safety clearance under the Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China, including documented forklift operator certification, personal protective equipment protocols, liquid spill containment procedures, hazardous goods segregation, and a comprehensive accident emergency response plan filed with the local workplace safety authority before commencing bonded storage operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online portal: Electronic Tax Bureau (e-tax bureau) / National Integrated Online Tax Service Platform. Customs and bonded depot clearing are coordinated through the General Administration of Customs (GACC) and the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign investors incorporate the WFOE as a limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). After name registration and approval against the Foreign Investment Negative List, SAMR issues the WFOE Business License bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC); the USCC is the PRC taxpayer identification number (TIN) and VAT registration identifier. SAMR transmits the incorporation record to STA under the Multi-Certificate Integration / One License One Code system, so no separate tax registration certificate is issued. Within 30 days of license issuance, the legal representative files the tax registration information report and completes the taxpayer profile in the Electronic Tax Bureau, including registered address, business scope, banking account, accounting method, and bonded warehouse site information. The WFOE then elects its VAT status: if annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5 million, registration as a VAT general taxpayer is mandatory; if below that threshold, it may elect small-scale or general VAT taxpayer status. It then obtains fiscal invoicing capability through the Tax UKey and/or the fully digitalised electronic invoice account administered by STA. For bonded warehouse operations, the WFOE must separately register with GACC to obtain a customs registration code, apply for Bonded Warehouse Registration and customs supervised warehouse approval, and establish the bonded warehouse electronic account through the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No pass-through, check-the-box, or hybrid mismatch election exists in PRC tax law; a WFOE is always treated as a resident enterprise subject to entity-level corporate income tax. The available elections are: (i) VAT taxpayer status election between small-scale taxpayer and VAT general taxpayer, subject to the RMB 5 million annual taxable turnover threshold; and (ii) simplified VAT calculation election for specific listed service transactions at reduced collection rates when lawfully available. Hybrid mismatch election is not available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax); national standard headline rate 13% applies to goods, 9% to transport and construction, and 6% to modern services including warehouse and storage services; 0% applies to qualifying exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 (annual taxable sales excluding VAT) is the statutory threshold for mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration; all business entities must complete tax registration upon incorporation irrespective of turnover. Small-scale taxpayer monthly sales below the applicable VAT exemption threshold are exempt from filing that period.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates real-time invoice clearance through the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform for fully digitalised electronic invoices (full-electronic invoices), with centrally generated invoice numbers, tax-control encryption, QR anti-fraud stamping, and real-time transmission of issuance data. Taxpayers using traditional fiscal invoicing issue VAT invoices through the VAT Invoice Management System and upload invoice data to STA in real-time; offline issuance is not permitted. Bonded warehouse imports, exports, re-exports, and entry-exit records are filed electronically through the China International Trade Single Window under GACC supervision; no manual paper stamping is acceptable for these statutory records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: a 0% VAT rate applies to goods sold and physically exported from mainland China to a destination outside the PRC customs territory, including re-export of bonded goods from a customs free trade zone or bonded depot. The exporter or taxpayer claiming zero-rating must hold a valid Customs Export Declaration evidencing an export or bonded re-export procedure, international transport documents, and evidence that the sale proceeds have been repatriated to China in foreign exchange within the prescribed period. Services: only cross-border taxable services wholly consumed outside China and expressly listed by STA qualify for zero-rating or exemption; bonded warehouse storage and logistics services physically performed inside the PRC customs territory remain taxable at 6% VAT regardless of the foreign identity of the customer because the place of supply is in China. The bonded zone is a customs supervision and deferred-duty arrangement, not a VAT-exemption zone.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (China Customs export goods declaration filed through the China International Trade Single Window, showing the export or bonded re-export customs procedure)
Bill of Lading or air waybill or equivalent international transport document evidencing physical departure of the goods from China

Inward Remittance Certificate / bank foreign exchange receipt confirmation issued by a SAFE-authorized bank, evidencing that the overseas buyer's payment for the exported goods has been repatriated to the WFOE's bank account in China
Export commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration value, quantity, and marks
Bonded warehouse entry-exit ledger and GACC supervision records if the goods are re-exported from the bonded depot
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, GACC, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange jointly scrutinise export declarations, logistics data, bonded warehouse records, and foreign exchange receipts. False declarations or documentation to obtain zero-rated treatment or export tax rebates are treated as fraudulent tax refunds under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection and the Criminal Law. Penalties include recovery of the unpaid or fraudulently refunded VAT, fines from 50% to 500% of the tax involved, suspension or forfeiture of export tax rebate rights, downgrade of the enterprise's SAFE trade-in-goods classification, cancellation of customs bonded warehouse registration, personal liability for responsible officers, and criminal prosecution for defrauding the State of export tax rebates. Retroactive recovery is not time-limited for fraudulent schemes, and the tax authorities may reopen previously cleared export filings and reassess VAT, customs duties, and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed float for the Renminbi under a statutory regime that combines current account convertibility with capital account administrative controls. Since China accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, legitimate trade and service payments may generally be converted and remitted on the basis of supporting documents, while the Renminbi remains restricted in capital account transactions. A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise in a bonded free trade zone must complete SAFE foreign direct investment registration or a delegated-bank filing, open a foreign exchange capital account, and apply funds only to approved business purposes. Capital contributions must be reported to SAFE, verified by a Chinese certified public accountant, and matched against the investment purpose. Profit distribution to foreign shareholders is recognized as a current account item only after the annual statutory audit, tax clearance, and SAFE filing; dividends may then be remitted abroad subject to board resolutions, audited financial statements, and a bank authenticity review. The old mandatory foreign exchange surrender regime has been replaced by a repatriation and verification regime: goods trade export proceeds must be collected in China and reconciled with customs declarations, but the exporter may retain the currency in a foreign currency account or sell it to the bank for Renminbi at market rates. There is no fixed conversion ratio. Bonded depot operators must also reconcile warehouse receipts, customs entry and exit records, and payment flows because the goods remain under customs supervision until re-exportation, making movement between bonded and non-bonded accounts a significant compliance risk.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The mandatory pre-reform foreign exchange surrender system has been abolished. Under SAFE goods trade administration, export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic designated foreign currency account and reconciled with customs export data, generally within 90 days of the export declaration unless a deferred receipt registration is approved by SAFE through the trade monitoring system. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; the exporter may retain the foreign currency or convert it to Renminbi at prevailing market rates. The bank will require an electronic customs declaration, invoice, contract, and the SAFE goods trade verification code before accepting settlement or transfer.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account and RMB Basic Operating Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account and Foreign Currency Treasury Account
Foreign Exchange Capital Account and Bonded Warehouse Operational Settlement Account
SAFE-Registered Capital Account and RMB Settlement Account for Bonded Trading

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore financial technology EMIs, including global digital neobanks and cross-border payment platforms, are not licensed as deposit-taking banks in mainland China and cannot lawfully open primary deposit or treasury settlement accounts for a domestic WFOE. PBOC and SAFE require RMB and foreign currency settlement files to be handled by SAFE-designated banking institutions or licensed payment institutions with cross-border payment qualifications; foreign digital EMIs generally fall outside the approved account infrastructure for a Chinese corporate treasury. For a bonded warehouse operator, such EMIs are not viable for capital verification, statutory FX filings, or operational clearing and should only be considered as auxiliary collection tools through a licensed local payment partner or a designated bank cross-border product.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for the statutory legal representative or a properly authorized senior signatory at the opening of the SAFE capital account and the RMB basic account. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted as a standalone procedure under PBOC account opening and AML rules for a medium-risk WFOE treasury; the bank requires a face-to-face interview, original corporate chops, business license, and FDI registration documents. If a statutory director is outside mainland China, the board may appoint an in-country legal representative or issue a notarized and legalized power of attorney, but the bank compliance committee will still require video or physical identity verification and presentation of original documents at a physical branch in the free trade zone.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership transiting through offshore holding companies in opaque jurisdictions with no clear economic purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate ownership chart from the WFOE to every natural person; certificates of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors and shareholders for each intermediate entity; passport copies of ultimate individual owners; six months of parent-company bank statements; notarized declarations of source of wealth signed by each UBO; and an external legal opinion introducing and validating the ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bonded warehouse license and customs registration inconsistent with declared trading activity or missing physical substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid customs clearance registration certificate for the free trade zone; bonded warehouse license or zone operating permit; lease or ownership proof for the bonded depot; warehouse management system screenshots with two years of storage, receipt, and issue ledgers; employee social insurance contribution schedules; photographs or video of the facility; and a board-approved business plan showing projected trade flows, counterparties, inventory turnover, and bonded logistics capability.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsettled proceeds or recurring late collection of export earnings creating an adverse flag under SAFE goods trade monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed sales contracts and purchase orders; commercial invoices, packing lists, and bill of lading or air waybill evidence; customs export declarations; bank MT103 credit advices; a certified accounts receivable aging report; warehouse dispatch records; and a written reconciliation letter prepared by the external auditor specifically explaining each overdue collection event.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injection with no evidential tie to the registered investment amount or funds sourced from non-bank lending channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration receipt; capital contribution schedule and board resolution; SAFE-approved capital account details; inward SWIFT MT103 payment where the remitter exactly matches the FDI shareholder; source-of-funds evidence including audited investor financial statements, tax returns, and solvency letters; and a post-remittance capital verification report issued by a PRC certified public accountant before funds are deployed.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injection must be structured as a SWIFT MT103 wire from the overseas corporate shareholder to the WFOE's SAFE-registered Foreign Exchange Capital Account at a designated Chinese bank. The remittance purpose must be declared as Foreign Direct Investment Equity Contribution, and the bank will file the SAFE direct investment declaration code on the inward transfer. The WFOE must hold the FDI registration receipt, complete the foreign exchange business registration, and, after remittance, instruct the bank to convert into RMB or retain the foreign currency within the approved business scope. A PRC certified public accountant then issues the capital verification report. For bonded warehouse operations, capital account funds must be segregated from bonded logistics expenses, customs deposits, and ordinary operating flows; transfers from the capital account to general RMB accounts must satisfy the real-use and authenticity review requirements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for cross-border wire transfers in USD, EUR, or CNY, through CIPS for RMB cross-border settlements, and through domestic clearing for free trade zone transactions involving Chinese counterparties. For bulk trade settlements, banks may issue Commercial Letters of Credit, sight or usance, backed by warehouse receipts and customs declarations, and may handle documentary collections on a documents against payment or documents against acceptance basis. Every outbound payment requires the trade contract, invoice, transport and customs documents, and the SAFE goods trade verification code. Because the depot is inside a free trade zone, goods may enter bonded storage and later be re-exported or transferred to the domestic market after duty payment; the selected clearing rail must match the customs declaration type to avoid mismatched trade data and compliance findings.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB FX forward contracts executed with a SAFE-designated bank under real trade exposure
Onshore FX swaps between RMB and USD or EUR where the underlying trade settlement plan is documented
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for medium-term capital and trade financing liabilities, limited to actual cash flow exposure
Onshore FX options sold by banks on a real hedging basis, subject to PBOC and SAFE product eligibility and transaction evidence
Offshore RMB NDFs are not a permitted hedging channel for a domestic WFOE; treasury hedging must remain centered on onshore CIPS and SWIFT clearing rails

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Information Report and Foreign-Investment Information Report (combined annual report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, co-filed with the Ministry of Commerce and local commerce authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of the immediately succeeding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to publish by June 30 results in listing on the enterprise abnormal-operations register, restrictions on market-registration changes, and after three consecutive non-compliant years the enterprise is exposed to administrative strike-off and placement on the serious illegal and untrustworthy list; false or omitted annual data may be fined from RMB 10,000 to RMB 30,000 (approximately USD 1,400 to USD 4,200).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement Return and annual financial statement filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local tax service bureau of the WFOE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following the reporting fiscal year; approved special-tax-treatment cases may extend to September 30 upon official extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest accrues at 0.05 percent per day on the unpaid tax amount; late filing penalties range from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 280 to USD 1,400); understated tax is subject to a fine of 50 percent to 5 times the unpaid amount; continued non-payment can trigger asset seizure, bank-account freeze, customs-credit suspension, and administrative revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory CPA audit report for the wholly foreign-owned enterprise and audited annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed PRC certified public accountant firm; audit report submitted with the SAMR and Ministry of Commerce combined annual report and retained for tax authority and foreign-exchange compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than May 31 for tax-settlement support and in all cases by the June 30 combined annual-report deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain a required statutory audit causes rejection of the foreign-investment annual report, placement on the abnormal-operations register, inability to evidence capital-account and foreign-exchange compliance, potential customs bonded-depot license review action, and administrative fines for providing false or incomplete financial reports.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Customs Supervision Enterprise Annual Report for the bonded warehouse operator
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Customs of the People's Republic of China through the China International Trade Single Window and the supervising customs office of the free-trade zone
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: June 30 annually, aligned with the combined enterprise annual-report window applicable to customs-regulated enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file invalidates or suspends the customs registration number, blocks bonded-goods declaration and customs clearance, and may attract a customs penalty of up to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 1,400); continued default can trigger cancellation of the bonded warehouse registration and forced de-bonding of stored cargo.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual bonded warehouse inventory reconciliation and stocktaking statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Supervising customs office of the free-trade zone where the bonded depot is licensed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the exact date directed by the supervising customs office through the bonded-warehouse annual verification protocol, normally within the first quarter after each fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unapproved inventory shortages require payment of the short-paid customs duty, taxes, and interest; administrative fines may be applied for the shortfall value; intentional inventory falsification can lead to suspension or cancellation of bonded-warehouse status and criminal referral for smuggling-related conduct.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership information declaration and ownership-change update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR enterprise registration authority operating the national beneficial-ownership information system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial filing at registration; updated filing within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding transfer; annual confirmation effected through the June 30 combined annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report beneficial-ownership changes within the 30-day window or knowingly submitting false beneficial-ownership data is subject to fines from RMB 10,000 to RMB 200,000 (approximately USD 1,400 to USD 28,000), joint market-access restrictions, and administrative penalties on the legal representative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer annual social insurance and housing fund contribution base declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local human resources and social security bureau, housing fund management center, and the tax authority as social-insurance collection agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual base-declaration window published by each municipal government, generally falling between March 1 and July 31, with final payroll reconciliation by December 31 of the contribution year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under-declared bases or late declarations attract daily late fees of 0.05 percent, social-insurance administrative penalties, restriction on customs credit rating, loss of export-tax-refund facilitation, and personal liability exposure for the company representative.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For this WFOE, the statutory audit is triggered categorically by foreign ownership: the entity is 100 percent foreign-invested and therefore has no audit exemption based on small size. Under PRC foreign-investment information reporting and the accounting regulatory framework, a wholly foreign-owned enterprise must submit annual financial statements audited by a licensed PRC CPA firm. In the PRC enterprise-size classification applicable to warehousing and logistics activities, mandatory full independent audit is nonetheless reinforced if any two of the following quantitative thresholds are exceeded: total assets of RMB 50 million, annual operating revenue of RMB 100 million, or 300 full-time employees. Separate audited-financial-statement obligations arise if the WFOE holds AEO customs certification, holds a bonded-warehouse operating license, seeks government procurement rights, applies for high-tech enterprise status, or uses bank credit facilities secured by the bonded warehouse assets.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS), which are substantially converged with IFRS; the statutory audit must follow PRC Certified Public Accountant Auditing Standards issued by the Ministry of Finance. IFRS financial statements alone are not an acceptable statutory filing basis, and the simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards are not available to this foreign-invested bonded warehouse operator.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PRC Interim Measures for Beneficial Ownership Information Management, the WFOE must file beneficial-ownership data at formation and must file an updated declaration within 30 days after any change in beneficial owner or shareholding transfer. There is no separate standalone annual UBO return; instead, the combined annual enterprise information report due by June 30 reconfirms and updates ownership, shareholding, and beneficial-ownership information. Equity transfers require simultaneous updating of the SAMR shareholder register and the beneficial-ownership system; failure to update within the 30-day window renders the information-reporting status non-compliant and exposes the enterprise to fines and market-access restrictions.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Executive Officers
Register of Charges, Mortgages and Equity Pledges
Register of Customs Bonded Warehouse Inventory Ledgers
Financial Accounting Books, Vouchers and Supporting Evidence

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 to USD 2,800 per year for a registered address or licensed corporate service provider in a Chinese free-trade zone; physical bonded warehouse lease and customs bond costs are additional
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 to USD 5,000 for a medium-size WFOE with bonded warehouse operations and moderate transaction volume; USD 8,000 to USD 15,000 where group consolidation, intercompany transactions, or complex customs-tax positions require expanded audit procedures

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying small low-profit enterprises (annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million, total assets up to RMB 50 million, and employees up to 300) may reduce taxable income to 25% and apply a 20% rate, yielding a 5% effective rate; National High-Tech Enterprises are eligible for a 15% preferential rate; qualified R&D expenses benefit from a 100% additional deduction (i.e., total 200% deduction) until the applicable sunset deadline; high-tech enterprises and technology small-and-medium enterprises may carry tax losses forward for up to 10 years. The bonded-zone depot itself does not automatically receive an income tax holiday, but customs duty and VAT deferral benefits apply to bonded goods and warehousing operations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) - final settlement and related schedules; quarterly advance-payment returns are also filed through the State Taxation Administration's Electronic Tax Bureau (e-tax filing system) at the local competent tax authority port.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final reconciliation with mandatory quarterly advance payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly advance EIT returns must be filed within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter; the annual final return must be filed within five months after the fiscal year-end (for a calendar-year taxpayer, by May 31 of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification and registration status: Unified Social Credit Code, legal name in English and registered Chinese form, registered address in the Free Trade Zone, bonded depot operating license number, ISIC 5210 / NAICS 493110 business activity code, and tax status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE is a PRC tax resident and must report worldwide income. Non-resident shareholders are not listed as income items here, but their identity, shareholding percentage, and address must be accurately disclosed in related-party schedules and withholding schedules because these facts determine eligibility for treaty-reduced dividend withholding rates and beneficial ownership review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue declaration: gross revenue from bonded warehousing, storage fees, cargo handling, inventory management, container depot services, logistics services, value-added processing, and other operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue in RMB using the official central bank exchange rate on the transaction date. Services physically performed inside PRC customs-controlled bonded zones are PRC-source revenue and are fully taxable. If the WFOE is compensated by a non-resident principal through a foreign-group clearing account, the invoice, contract, wire evidence, and transfer pricing file must substantiate that the revenue has been declared in China; under-reporting is a criminal tax evasion trigger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and expenses: cost of goods sold, wages and welfare, rent, depreciation, utilities, third-party logistics, customs brokerage, insurance, repairs, professional fees, and financial expenses, adjusted by tax law limitations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to non-resident affiliates (management fees, royalties, interest, service fees) are deductible only if supported by contracts, arm's-length pricing, withholding tax clearance, and actual services provided. Interest paid to a related non-resident lender is subject to thin-capitalisation restrictions (2:1 debt-to-equity for general enterprises), and the entire expense may be disallowed if no substance exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income reconciliation: accounting profit plus and minus tax adjustments, including non-deductible expenditures, tax-exempt income, loss carryforwards, and prior-year special tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward for five years; qualifying high-tech loss carryforward is ten years. Related-party transactions that are not at arm's length are subject to special tax adjustment with a ten-year look-back period. The WFOE must maintain contemporaneous evidence that the bonded-depot activity is performed in China and that no artificial profit shifting occurs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: applying the 25% standard rate, or applicable preferential rate, to taxable income, then reducing by the foreign tax credit and any domestic tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE's worldwide income is taxable at 25%; the foreign tax credit is capped by the PRC tax attributable to the same foreign-source income. Any free-zone preferential rate must be claimed and supported by the applicable State Council catalogue; a pure bond-holding shell or contract-manufacturing warehouse without economic substance will not qualify.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding and non-resident declaration: disclosure of dividend distributions, interest, royalties, rental, and other payments made or accrued to non-resident enterprises, including the statutory withholding rate, treaty-reduced rate claimed, and beneficial ownership certification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For every outbound payment to a non-resident, the WFOE as withholding agent must report gross amount, 10% statutory WHT, versus treaty rate, and attach the non-resident's tax residency certificate, treaty claim form, and beneficial-ownership evidence. If the WFOE fails to withhold, it is jointly liable for the uncollected tax, interest, and penalties under Article 69 of the Tax Collection Administration Law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal representative director statement and signature, confirming the return and attached schedules are true, complete, and accurate, and that the entity is not engaged in shell or against public policy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE director must personally sign the filing declaration. A director cannot rely on separate corporate personality to escape liability if false documents, bonded cargo diversion, transfer-pricing fraud, or treaty abuse is found; the director's personal travel, bank accounts, and criminal exposure can be implicated in a serious tax or customs enforcement case.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fines range from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, increased to RMB 20,000 for serious cases, plus a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax. Understatement or false returns are penalised at 50% to 500% of the evaded tax; criminal liability is available under Criminal Law Article 201 with imprisonment of up to seven years for tax evasion and potentially life imprisonment for smuggling. Customs violations in a bonded depot can additionally result in fines up to three times the duties evaded, confiscation of goods, revocation of the bonded licence, and public blacklisting.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory PRC enterprise income tax withholding on dividends paid to a non-resident enterprise without an establishment or place of business in China; many tax treaties reduce this to 5% when the beneficial owner is a company that holds at least 25% of the capital.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident recipient must, before or at the time of payment, provide the Chinese withholding agent with: (1) a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the treaty jurisdiction tax authority for the year in which the income arises; (2) a Beneficial Ownership self-declaration and supporting substance evidence; (3) the appropriate treaty-benefit claim form used by China's tax administration; and (4) transaction documents (shareholding register, loan agreement, royalty licence, invoices, payment receipts). The withholding agent then files the Non-resident Enterprise Withholding Tax Return with the local tax authority, reports the reduced treaty rate, and retains all documentation. If the reduced rate was not applied at source, the non-resident can apply for a refund of excess withholding within three years under the Tax Collection Administration Law. The tax authority may deny treaty benefits where the recipient is a conduit without real business activities, employees, premises, or core income-generating functions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on interest and royalties paid to non-resident enterprises is 10%; royalties and certain technical/franchise payments may also be subject to VAT (generally 6%) and local surcharges. Treaty rates commonly range from 5% to 10% for interest and royalties; for example, China's DTA with Hong Kong often reduces royalties to 7% under specific conditions, and interest may be reduced to 7% or 5% for financial institutions, depending on the treaty. All treaty reductions require the beneficial owner in the counterpart jurisdiction to satisfy the substantive ownership and economic-substance tests; otherwise the 10% domestic statutory rate applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Announcement No. 42 of 2016, the Local File contemporaneous documentation is mandatory when annual related-party transactions exceed the following thresholds: RMB 200 million for transfers of tangible property; RMB 100 million for transfers of intangible property; RMB 100 million for rendering of services; RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers; and RMB 100 million for financial transactions such as loans and guarantees. The Master File must be maintained when the Chinese taxpayer belongs to a multinational group whose consolidated group revenue was RMB 5.5 billion or more in the prior fiscal year; Country-by-Country (CbC) reporting applies at the same RMB 5.5 billion group-revenue threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies statutory and general anti-avoidance substance-over-form principles (EIT Law Article 47 and SAT Announcement No. 9 of 2018 on beneficial ownership) rather than a named Economic Substance Regulations regime. For a bonded-zone depot WFOE, the entity must have physical facilities, employees, warehouse equipment, inventory management systems, customs supervision capability, and actual decision-making authority in China. If the entity is a mere titleholder or conduit with no real core income-generating activities (CIGA) in the bonded zone, the tax authority may disregard the entity, recharacterise the transactions, reassign profits to the real business owners, and deny treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Bonded Cargo Diversion and Customs Smuggling
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a bonded depot and selling or transferring bonded goods into the domestic Chinese market without completing formal import customs clearance and without paying customs duties, import VAT, and consumption tax, while documenting the goods as re-exported to a non-resident customer; includes forged customs seals, false warehouse receipts, phantom inventory records, and double-invoicing to hide the diversion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Customs Law Article 82 and Criminal Law Article 153. The customs authority imposes fines of 50% to 300% of the evaded duties/taxes, confiscates smuggled goods, transport means, and illegal gains, and revokes the bonded warehouse licence; deliberate smuggling constitutes a crime punishable by unlimited fines and seizure of property, in addition to imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and actual controllers who ordered, participated in, or knowingly benefited from the diversion are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid duties, taxes, and penalties through veil-piercing. They are subject to asset freezing, confiscation, travel bans, exit-restriction orders, customs/tax blacklisting, and individual criminal prosecution with imprisonment of up to ten years or life imprisonment in especially serious smuggling cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Base Erosion Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accruing or paying management fees, royalties, logistics fees, interest, or excessive service charges to a non-resident parent or affiliate without performing the actual services, without maintaining contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation, or without arm's-length pricing, thereby leaving no taxable profit in the Chinese WFOE; also includes falsification of intercompany contracts and circular cash flows to strip profit offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Articles 41, 44, 46, and 47; SAT Announcement No. 42 of 2016; Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63. The tax authority may make transfer pricing adjustments, disallow the deduction, impose loan-based interest (including penalty interest), and assess penalties from 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax. Large intentional concealment triggers criminal tax evasion liability under Criminal Law Article 201.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally sued for restitution of the corporate tax underpayment when the corporate veil is pierced for fraud; entry-exit restriction and blacklisting under the Joint Punishment for Tax Dishonesty system apply; and a director who intentionally created false related-party structures may face criminal imprisonment of up to seven years, with confiscation of personal assets obtained from the scheme.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty Abuse, Shell Conduit and Fraudulent Dividend Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting up a Hong Kong, Singapore, or other treaty-jurisdiction intermediate holding company with no employees, offices, business functions, or economic substance, and channelling dividends, interest, or royalties through that conduit solely to obtain a reduced DTA withholding rate, while the real beneficial owner is in a non-treaty jurisdiction; also includes signing sham dividend declarations and wiring funds to offshore personal accounts to evade the 10% statutory WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 47 (general anti-abuse rule); SAT Announcement No. 9 of 2018 (beneficial ownership); Tax Collection Administration Law Articles 36 and 69. The tax authority will disregard the conduit, recharacterize the income as directly paid to the ultimate non-resident, deny the treaty rate, recapture the full 10% WHT, impose late-payment interest and penalties of 50% to 500% of the unpaid tax, and hold the WFOE as withholding agent jointly liable for any unwithheld amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who designed, authorised, or executed the shell-conduit arrangement are jointly and severally liable for the unwithheld tax and penalties; their personal assets can be seized, they may be placed on the tax-honesty blacklist, subjected to travel bans and exit restrictions, and prosecuted criminally for tax evasion or fraudulent non-resident declarations, with imprisonment terms of up to seven years, or longer if the scheme is linked to money laundering or smuggling proceeds.
